points.point: Vault 沒有提供 Signal Integrity 的定義，只保存來源明示的測試區塊與儀器類型對應；因此「signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope」這個具名概念在 Vault 中無定義依據。
points.label: partial
points.why: Says KB lacks a validated full answer, but still gives a derived definition and does not state the named concept has no Vault definition

points.point: Slide 11 將 Interface Test 對應到 scopes、BERTs、AWGs、switch matrices，這是 Vault 中 SI 與示波器之間最直接的對應。
points.label: covered
points.why: States Interface Test maps to oscilloscopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices

points.point: Power Distribution Network 測試區塊同時對應 scopes 與 network analyzers，意即 PDN / 電源完整性量測需在示波器與網路分析儀之間做選擇。
points.label: covered
points.why: States PDN testing maps to oscilloscopes and network analyzers

points.point: Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA 的項目為 IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram、TDR Impedance、Stackup Planner、TL Calculator。
points.label: covered
points.why: Lists IL, Xtalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation

points.point: Signal Integrity modeling/testing 流程階段對應 IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance，而非示波器量測項目。
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions IL, Dk/Df, roughness, and impedance in SI modeling/testing, but does not clarify these are not oscilloscope measurement items

points.point: AI server 對照表把示波器系列 MXO 列在 power rail、multiphase DC、PI 與 motor driver analysis，顯示示波器在 PI 相關量測的產品對應。
points.label: missing
points.why: Does not mention the AI server table or MXO being listed for power rail, multiphase DC, PI, and motor driver analysis

points.point: Vault 明確限制：不可把這些儀器類型列名推論為 R&S 具備所有方案或轉換成正式 product configuration。
points.label: partial
points.why: Says no formal product configuration is supported, but does not mention the restriction against inferring all R&S solutions

points.point: Slide 11 的儀器對應未提供型號、頻寬、資料率或測試標準，無法支撐具體產品選型決策。
points.label: partial
points.why: States no model, option, bandwidth, data-rate, pass/fail, or formal configuration support, but omits test standards

invented: “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” is best understood as the link between signal integrity / high-speed digital / SerDes / SI-PI / PCB-PCBA validation and the use of an oscilloscope
